subject: Planned AppSet Rollout & Governance — Q4 expansion to additional projects
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Tim Avery <tim.avery@averylabs.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Planned AppSet Rollout & Governance — initial proposal

Hi Tim —

Following our call this morning, attached is a first-pass rollout spreadsheet (appset-rollout-v1.xlsx) that maps the five new projects your teams want to onboard in Q4 to planned API key groups, staged provisioning windows, and a proposed canary cadence. Key asks from our side:

- Confirm which projects should be grouped under a single API key namespace vs. separate keys (we recommended separation for the externally facing apps).
- Identify the internal approver for production key issuance (we flagged Priya on the call).
- Share any fixed SLA or billing constraints we should bake into the reserved capacity proposal.

High-level timeline suggestion: provision keys for two pilot projects in week 1 of Nov, expand to remaining three over Nov–Dec with a capacity uplift effective 12/1. If that works, we’ll draft a short amendment to your existing contract and include the reserved capacity add-on.

Next step: can we lock a 30-minute alignment on Monday (10/12) to confirm the grouping and approver? I copied Laura and Ben for capacity and ops input.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0128

Attachment: appset-rollout-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 12KB)

From: Tim Avery <tim.avery@averylabs.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@averylabs.com>
Date: 2026-10-08T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Planned AppSet Rollout & Governance — initial proposal

Thanks Stephanie — this looks promising. Quick clarifications:

- We prefer separate keys for the external-facing customer portal and the analytics ingestion pipeline. Internal tools can share a namespace.
- SLA: we’ll need 99.9% latency SLA during business hours for the portal.
- Billing: we’re open to a committed reserved capacity uplift if the unit economics are acceptable.

Looping in Priya to confirm who will be the legal/approver contact for production keys. Monday at 09:30 PT works for me.

—Tim
Head of Engineering, Avery Labs
Tim.Avery@averylabs.com

Appreciate the quick reply, Tim — noted on separate keys for portal and ingestion. Laura and Monica from Ops are copied and have started a short MOP (operations playbook) for the pilot that includes key rotation cadence, tagging conventions, and rollback steps. I attached the draft: mop-appset-v1.pdf.

Concrete next steps I’ll take before Monday:
- Draft a one-page amendment that adds a reserved capacity line item tied to the five new projects (will reference DL-7724).
- Ben will provide a capacity uplift estimate and associated billing delta.
- Ops team will circulate the MOP and keying standard for your security review.

If Priya can share the legal contact and any procurement timeline constraints, we’ll aim to have a DocuSign-ready amendment by 10/15.

Best,
Stephanie

Attachment: mop-appset-v1.pdf (draft operations playbook, 48KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, Tim Avery <tim.avery@averylabs.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-10T08:55:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Planned AppSet Rollout & Governance — capacity notes

Tim / Stephanie — quick capacity note from infra: supporting the five projects as separate key namespaces with a pilot of two projects will require roughly a 30% uplift to the existing reserved pool to keep tail latency under the 99.9% target you asked for. I attached a very rough estimate.

Highlights:
- Pilot (2 projects): incremental reserved GPU-hours ~ 180 hrs/month -> estimated monthly delta $8.2k.
- Full roll (5 projects): incremental reserved GPU-hours ~ 520 hrs/month -> estimated monthly delta $22.5k.
- We recommend an initial 3-month commit for the uplift to smooth pricing and provide burst capacity for onboarding.

I can formalize this into a pricing appendix for the amendment once legal signals they’re ready.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: capacity-estimate.csv (CSV, 4KB)

From: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@averylabs.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Tim Avery <tim.avery@averylabs.com>, Contracts Team <contracts@lawfirm.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Planned AppSet Rollout & Governance — legal & security prerequisites

Thanks — a couple items from legal and security:

- Please provide the most recent SOC 2 snapshot and Data Processing Addendum language. We need SOC 2 evidence before we can sign any 3-month reserved commitment.
- On the amendment, we’ll need a clause for step-down rights if traffic drops below agreed thresholds after the 3-month period.
- For API keys: our security team prefers a single admin per namespace with SSO provisioning.

Contracts team — I’ve copied you. Expect a short redline on the amendment and a request for standard indemnity/limitation language.

Priya Sharma
VP, Platform & Security, Avery Labs
Priya.Sharma@averylabs.com
